data.description: The RHIB is a boat for moving a crew and loot over water, with 6 seats and 36 slots of storage. A RHIB costs 300 [scrap](/items/scrap) at the [Boat Vendor](/world/boat-vendor) and comes with 50 low grade, and a full 500 tank lasts about 33 minutes. It decays in 3 hours outside and 2 hours in deep water, but not at all while it's inside.
